body_markdown:
Reservoir Media, Inc. (NASDAQ: RSVR), an award-winning independent music company, today announced a new publishing deal with Diamond-selling songwriter-producer Fred Ball to publish his future works.


Based in London, Ball is a songwriter and producer whose catalog has garnered billions of global streams to date. Throughout his career, Ball has collaborated with some of the industry’s biggest artists including Beyoncé, Jay-Z, Eminem, Alicia Keys, Madonna, Mariah Carey, Madison Beer, Olivia Dean, Zara Larsson, and RAYE, among others. He has contributed to five Grammy nominations, including the Grammy Award-winning album *Everything Is Love* by Beyoncé and Jay-Z.


Ball is best known for co-writing and co-producing Rihanna’s RIAA-certified Diamond single “Love On The Brain,” which peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. *Billboard* also named it the most influential pop single of 2017 and ranked Ball #8 on its Hot 100 Top 10 Producers list that same year. “Love On The Brain” has since exceeded 2.2 billion streams on Spotify alone.


Ball’s other notable credits include “713,” “Friends,” and “Heard About Us” off the previously mentioned *Everything Is Love* ; “Nice Guy” featuring Jessie Reyez off Eminem’s #1 album *Kamikaze* ; “One Mo’ Gen” off Mariah Carey’s critically acclaimed album *Caution* ; and “Dientes” by J Balvin, Usher, and DJ Khaled, which reached #1 on the Latin Airplay chart. He continues to be an in-demand collaborator for top-tier artists.


On signing with Reservoir, Ball said, “I’m so excited to be joining the Reservoir family. Their belief in my music and commitment to artistry made this an easy decision, and I can’t wait to see what we can build together.”


Reservoir Senior Creative Manager Russell Hunt also added, “Fred is a world class songwriter and producer whose talent, craft, and dedication have gained him commercial and critical success across several genres and markets. He has contributed to some of the most globally influential records of the past decade and more, and he continues to work with top-tier artists worldwide. We are thrilled and honored to support him as he adds to his ever-growing success.”
